label.devLabel: Derives a new 3D PCB Document from a sketch profile. The derived profile replaces the board outline sketch. Updates to the derived features in the original design reflect in the destination design.

label.devLabel: Edits the primary sketch that defines the board outline.
label.translation: Edits the primary sketch that defines the board outline.

label.translation: Create a closed profile to define the board. You can project geometry from the assembly context to ensure the PCB outline stays updated with the mechanical assembly.

label.devLabel: Rotates components along their X-axis and places them on the other side of a double-sided PCB.
label.translation: Rotates components along their X-axis and places them on the other side of a double-sided PCB.

label.devLabel: Synchronize changes between the 3D and 2D PCBs, and reroute to maintain correct electrical connections.
label.translation: Synchronize changes between the 3D and 2D PCBs, and reroute to maintain correct electrical connections.

label.devLabel: Repositions a component along the X- and Y- axes, or adjusts its angle on the board.
label.translation: Repositions a component along the X- and Y- axes, or adjusts its angle on the board.

label.devLabel: You can automatically reroute the traces and push the changes to the 2D PCB.
label.translation: You can automatically reroute the traces and push the changes to the 2D PCB.

label.devLabel: Edit the sketch generated from EAGLE board.
label.translation: Edit the sketch generated from EAGLE board.

label.translation: This command is only available when there's sketch generated from EAGLE board.

label.translation: This command will activate the sketch generated from EAGLE board for editing.

label.devLabel: Edit the sketch generated from EAGLE board
label.translation: Edit the sketch generated from EAGLE board

label.devLabel: Component or layer is locked. Switch to the 2D PCB document and unlock the component or layer. Edit the object position, then retry updating the 3D PCB.
label.translation: Component or layer is locked. Switch to the 2D PCB document and unlock the component or layer. Edit the object position, then retry updating the 3D PCB.

label.devLabel: Creates a 3D PCB document from the selected sketch or face.
label.translation: Creates a 3D PCB document from the selected sketch or face.

label.devLabel: Select a sketch or face, then select origin and axes orientation. You can convert circles into non-plated through holes (NPTHs).
label.translation: Select a sketch or face, then select origin and axes orientation. You can convert circles into non-plated through holes (NPTHs).

label.devLabel: Define the shape of the PCB via a sketched profile.
label.translation: Define the shape of the PCB via a sketched profile.

label.devLabel: Select a profile and an origin point.
label.translation: Select a profile and an origin point.

label.devLabel: After selecting the profile, you must choose an origin to ensure the communication with EAGLE is precise. One corner of the PCB normally works well. Decide if the profile is on the top or bottom of the PCB, and be sure that the extrusion direction is correct. The PCB shape will become visible to EAGLE after the model is saved, and the EAGLE user can change the shape of the board as well.
label.translation: After selecting the profile, you must choose an origin to ensure the communication with EAGLE is precise. One corner of the PCB normally works well. Decide if the profile is on the top or bottom of the PCB, and be sure that the extrusion direction is correct. The PCB shape will become visible to EAGLE after the model is saved, and the EAGLE user can change the shape of the board as well.

label.devLabel: Select a profile and an origin point.
label.translation: Select a profile and an origin point.

label.devLabel: Defines the PCB board outline and 2D coordinate system.
label.translation: Defines the PCB board outline and 2D coordinate system.

label.devLabel: Select one or more closed profiles from the Board Outline Sketch or mechanical assembly. Choose a point for the origin of the 2D coordinate system and an edge for the X axis. Flip the X and Z axes to set the desired Y axis.
label.translation: Select one or more closed profiles from the Board Outline Sketch or mechanical assembly. Choose a point for the origin of the 2D coordinate system and an edge for the X axis. Flip the X and Z axes to set the desired Y axis.

label.devLabel: Creates a new 3D PCB document as an external component in the assembly. If the board outline sketch references assembly geometry, the board updates with design changes.
label.translation: Creates a new 3D PCB document as an external component in the assembly. If the board outline sketch references assembly geometry, the board updates with design changes.

label.devLabel: Select location, then open the 3D PCB to complete a closed profile in the board outline to finish defining the board.
label.translation: Select location, then open the 3D PCB to complete a closed profile in the board outline to finish defining the board.

label.devLabel: Copies the profile supplied from EAGLE to an upstream Fusion sketch.
label.translation: Copies the profile supplied from EAGLE to an upstream Fusion sketch.

label.devLabel: This command is primarily useful when both the Fusion and EAGLE user are actively changing the shape of the PCB.
label.translation: This command is primarily useful when both the Fusion and EAGLE user are actively changing the shape of the PCB.

label.devLabel: Copies the profile supplied from EAGLE to an upstream Fusion sketch. You can copy to a pre-existing sketch, or create a new sketch by selecting a planar face or construction plane. The selected sketch or plane must be parallel to the PCB. If there is already an upstream sketch that drives the PCB feature, that sketch will be selected by default.
label.translation: Copies the profile supplied from EAGLE to an upstream Fusion sketch. You can copy to a pre-existing sketch, or create a new sketch by selecting a planar face or construction plane. The selected sketch or plane must be parallel to the PCB. If there is already an upstream sketch that drives the PCB feature, that sketch will be selected by default.

label.translation: Move PCB component body to align with the footprint on the board.

label.translation: Select a body from PCB component and move it by dragging or typing in values.

label.translation: Note that no Move feature will be created in the timeline. However, the new locations will be remembered by Fusion.

label.devLabel: Note that no Move feature will be created in the timeline. However, the new locations will be remembered by Fusion, and will become visible to EAGLE after the model is saved, and the EAGLE user can move the components as well.
label.translation: Note that no Move feature will be created in the timeline. However, the new locations will be remembered by Fusion, and will become visible to EAGLE after the model is saved, and the EAGLE user can move the components as well.

label.devLabel: Select a component and move it by dragging or typing in values.
label.translation: Select a component and move it by dragging or typing in values.

label.translation: Replace PCB component with different one.

label.translation: Note that no Move feature will be created in the timeline. However, the PCB component will be replace with new model, the change will not able to get back to eagle.

label.translation: Check the status of the PCB shape and component positions.

label.translation: Both the board shape and the component positions can be driven by either Fusion or EAGLE. Use this command to understand the state of the model.
